ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Muqun scans the Gateway's QR code to pair securely, and takes photos you attach to a terminal session.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Muqun sends photos you pick to the paired Gateway so an agent can read them.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Muqun uses Face ID to protect paired servers and terminal sessions.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Muqun connects to the Gateway running on your own computer, which may be on your local network.
